 SANJAY MUNDRA S/O SATYANARAYAN MUNDRA,
 AGED ABOUT 42 YEARS, OCCUPATION: BUSINESS, R/O:
 HOUSE NO. 1 NIKAS CHAURAHA, DISTRICT UJJAIN  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VIRENDRA SHARMA, ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE  OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION PANWASA  DISTRICT UJJAIN (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAHUL SOLANKI, GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 BY SHRI MANISH KUMAR JOSHI, ADVOCATE FOR THE OBJECTOR)
 This application coming on for order this day, th e cou  following:
 ORDER 01.

entities.text: STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as the applicant is apprehending his arrest relating to FIR/Crime No.209/2023 registered at Police Station Panwasa,
District Ujjain (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 120-B and 34 of IPC.
02.

As per the prosecution case, the applicant/accused had done forgery in the revenue records in respect of survey No.73/1 area 0.104 hectare and sold the same to the complainant for consideration of Rs.18 Lakh, thereby, the applicant has cheated the complainant.
03. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he was the real owner of the aforesaid land and he had purchased the land from Satpal Singh through registered sale-deed dated 25.06.2012.
Thereafter, he sold the aforesaid land in favour of the complainant by registered sale-deed dated 13.04.2017 (copy of both the registered sale-deeds are annexed with the record).

sentences.text: the applicant further submits that the applicant has not done any forgery in the revenue records.
Dispute is civil in nature.
The applicant is a reputed person.

The Police is trying to arrest him,
therefore, the applicant is entitled for anticipatory bail.
04. Learned counsel for the State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection the application.
05. Learned counsel for the objector has no objection.
06. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
07. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that this is a fit case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.

08. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the Arresting Officer, he shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
09. The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
Applicant shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
10. Accordingly, Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.23863 of 2023 stands allowed and disposed off.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE Shilpa Sanjay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130294416/
